# Typography

The type primitives and the text styles built from them: family, weight, size and line height, named once.

**Kind:** Foundation

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/styles/TokensTypography.mdx`

## Overview

A text style bundles family, weight, size, line height and tracking into one token ([Typography](?path=/docs/foundations-visual-typography--docs)). Features bind a text style, never a size on its own.
